text:
```yaml
name: Safe Inputs and MCP Gateway Specifications

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  generate-specifications:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v2
        with:
          go-version: '1.17'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: go mod tidy
      
      - name: Generate Safe Inputs Specification
        run: go run cmd/generate-safe-inputs-spec/main.go
      
      - name: Generate Safe Inputs JSON Schema
        run: go run cmd/generate-safe-inputs-schema/main.go
      
      - name: Commit and push changes
        run: |
          git config --global user.name 'github-actions[bot]'
          git config --global user.email 'github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
          git add docs/src/content/docs/reference/safe-inputs-specification.md docs/public/schemas/safe-inputs-config.schema.json
          git commit -m "Update Safe Inputs Specification and JSON Schema"
          git push origin main
```

This GitHub Actions workflow file will automatically generate the Safe Inputs specification document and JSON schema when changes are pushed to or opened against the `main` branch. The workflow uses Go to run the necessary commands to generate the files and then commits and pushes the changes back to the repository.
